attacks.name: Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Widow's Sting|: After this attack is resolved, the defender loses 1 |!power|.

attacks.name: Mixed Technique
steps: After this attack is resolved, if it dealt |!damage|, the defender gains the |§stagger§Stagger| special condition.
|!wild| |*Elusive|: After this attack is resolved, this character may Advance |!range_small|.

superPowers.name: Counter-Strike
superPowers.body: After an attack against this character is resolved, it may use this superpower. If the attacker is within |!range| 3, roll four dice. Deal 1 |!damage| to the attacker for each |!critical| and each |!wild| rolled.

superPowers.name: Martial Artist
superPowers.body: When this character is defending against a |!physical| or |!energy| attack targeting it from within |!range| 2, this character adds Blanks in its defense roll to its total successes.

superPowers.name: Stealth
superPowers.body: Characters must be within |!range| 3 of this character to target it with attacks.
